description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 score percentages for various datasets using different configurations of the MADLLM model. The horizontal axis represents the dataset categories, labeled as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, while the vertical axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, marked at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a dataset and containing four bars corresponding to different model configurations: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). The bars within each group are positioned adjacent to one another, allowing for direct comparison between the model configurations for each dataset. The F1 scores for the MADLLM configuration range from approximately 100% for SWaT to around 100% for SMD, with other datasets having scores close to 100%. The other configurations generally have lower F1 scores, with the lowest values observed for the WADI dataset, where the scores range from around 90% to below 70%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
